prompt: A coordination group absorbs conflicting requests, reducing disruption until the accumulated backlog requires an explicit unloading decision. Explain why a quiet surface need not mean spare capacity. Evidence is qualitative.
Two independent teams rely on a common authentication service. Adding another team does not remove the common dependency. Explain why redundancy can be apparent rather than real.

keyPoints.text: more teams does not eliminate common dependency

prompt: A restoration action is effective only while environmental conditions remain within a certain qualitative range. Beyond that range the same action can be ineffective. Distinguish conditional response from linear extrapolation.

keyPoints.text: outside range effectiveness is unknown or lower

prompt: Two regions use different tactics under one strategic constraint. Neither is subordinate to the other. Show common direction without suggesting identical execution.
A faster local stage creates additional backlog downstream because throughput at the next stage is unchanged. Explain why local speed does not imply system throughput.
Make an exact reference table for 12 part numbers, dimensions and tolerances. No mechanism explanation is needed. All cells must be searchable.
Two metrics move together over three periods; no causal evidence or process detail is available. Explain what can and cannot be inferred without inventing a mechanism.

keyPoints.text: no physical mechanism is claimed as fact
